# Pitch Collection Kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PitchCollectionKind`](gmeow-PitchCollectionKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchCollectionKind>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of a pitch collection, drawn from an open value vocabulary of individuals (scale, mode, maqam, jins, raga, thaat, pathet, mode of limited transposition, pitch-class set, row/series, spectrum collection). Never subclassed ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
